Edgewater Federal Solutions is hiring an Application Developer I to support a federal client. The role contributes to developing, maintaining, and modernizing enterprise applications in a Java-based environment, including application design, coding, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, and cloud modernization.
Information Technology
Professional Services
Information Services
Growth Opportunities
No H1B
U.S. Citizen Only
Responsibilities
Assist in the design, development, testing, and maintenance of enterprise applications within a Java / SQL / SpringBoot / front-end web application environment
Support development of RESTful services and user interfaces that integrate with enterprise applications and databases
Perform routine database tasks in Oracle and PostgreSQL, such as updating data structures, reviewing queries, and assisting with performance improvements
Troubleshoot and resolve basic application, interface, and database issues with support from senior developers and technical leads
Follow secure coding practices and assist with correcting vulnerabilities identified through testing or security reviews
Support implementation and maintenance of authentication and authorization mechanisms in accordance with established security requirements
Work with team members, customers, and stakeholders to understand business needs and help translate them into technical solutions
Participate in Agile development activities such as daily stand-ups, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives
Assist with application modernization and cloud migration activities, including code updates, testing, and documentation for AWS environments
Prepare and maintain technical documentation, including code comments, development notes, and standard operating procedures
Participate in code reviews, knowledge-sharing, and continuous improvement efforts to improve application quality and team performance
Support production and operational activities, including participation in on-call support rotation as assigned

Awareness of cloud platforms such as AWS is preferred

Familiarity with authentication concepts such as OAuth2
Interest in enterprise systems, modernization, and cloud technologies
